dataset_metadata.name: A.R.E.S. Med registry of spaceflight requirements and exposure limits
dataset_metadata.description: Each entry identifies its source revision, location and verification status. Rule summaries are project paraphrases. Nonempty verbatim_rule fields contain direct excerpts. Historical records describe superseded requirements.

rules.title: Crew selection and annual recertification
rules.rule_summary: OCHMO-STD-100.1A guides crew medical and psychological selection and annual recertification.
rules.search_text: V1 3001 Crew selection and annual recertification OCHMO-STD-100.1A guides crew medical and psychological selection and annual recertification.

rules.title: Historical Level I medical care
rules.source_revision: NASA-STD-3001 Volume 1, Revision A with Change 1 (superseded)
rules.rule_summary: Revision A covered first aid and follow-up planning for survival training, transfers to LEO vehicles and suborbital flights.
rules.search_text: Level I Historical Level I medical care Revision A covered first aid and follow-up planning for survival training, transfers to LEO vehicles and suborbital flights.

rules.title: Historical Level II medical care
rules.source_revision: NASA-STD-3001 Volume 1, Revision A with Change 1 (superseded)
rules.rule_summary: Revision A assigned basic life support and ambulatory diagnostics to LEO missions shorter than 30 days.
rules.search_text: Level II Historical Level II medical care Revision A assigned basic life support and ambulatory diagnostics to LEO missions shorter than 30 days.

rules.title: Historical Level III medical care
rules.source_revision: NASA-STD-3001 Volume 1, Revision A with Change 1 (superseded)
rules.rule_summary: Revision A provided limited advanced life support, trauma and dental care for short missions beyond LEO, including lunar or planetary missions up to 30 days.
rules.search_text: Level III Historical Level III medical care Revision A provided limited advanced life support, trauma and dental care for short missions beyond LEO, including lunar or planetary missions up to 30 days.

rules.title: Historical Level IV medical care
rules.source_revision: NASA-STD-3001 Volume 1, Revision A with Change 1 (superseded)
rules.rule_summary: Revision A covered LEO missions over 30 days and lunar or planetary surface stays over 30 and up to 210 days.
rules.search_text: Level IV Historical Level IV medical care Revision A covered LEO missions over 30 days and lunar or planetary surface stays over 30 and up to 210 days.

rules.title: Historical Level V medical care
rules.source_revision: NASA-STD-3001 Volume 1, Revision A with Change 1 (superseded)
rules.rule_summary: Revision A called for a physician-level caregiver on autonomous lunar or planetary missions over 210 days. Resources and mission risk limited available care.
rules.search_text: Level V Historical Level V medical care Revision A called for a physician-level caregiver on autonomous lunar or planetary missions over 210 days. Resources and mission risk limited available care.

rules.title: Planning in-mission medical capabilities
rules.rule_summary: Programs plan training, equipment and treatment capabilities around assessed risks, flight surgeon input, crew needs and vehicle constraints.
rules.search_text: V1 3004 Planning in-mission medical capabilities Programs plan training, equipment and treatment capabilities around assessed risks, flight surgeon input, crew needs and vehicle constraints.

rules.title: ALARA exposure minimization
rules.rule_summary: Minimize crew radiation exposure under the ALARA principle.
rules.verbatim_rule: All crewmember radiation exposures shall be minimized using the ALARA principle.
rules.search_text: V1 4029 ALARA exposure minimization Minimize crew radiation exposure under the ALARA principle.

rules.title: Career effective dose limit
rules.rule_summary: Total career spaceflight effective dose must stay below 600 mSv for every crewmember.
rules.search_text: V1 4030 Career effective dose limit Total career spaceflight effective dose must stay below 600 mSv for every crewmember.

rules.title: Solar particle event design limit
rules.rule_summary: Shielding design must keep effective dose below 250 mSv for the reference solar particle event based on the October 1989 events.
rules.search_text: V1 4031 Solar particle event design limit Shielding design must keep effective dose below 250 mSv for the reference solar particle event based on the October 1989 events.

rules.title: Exposure from nuclear technologies
rules.rule_summary: Effective dose from mission nuclear technologies must remain below 20 mSv per mission year, scaled to mission duration.
rules.search_text: V1 4032 Exposure from nuclear technologies Effective dose from mission nuclear technologies must remain below 20 mSv per mission year, scaled to mission duration.

rules.title: Galactic cosmic radiation design limits
rules.rule_summary: For habitats designed for more than 60 crewed days, keep GCR effective dose rates below 1.3 mSv/day in free space and 0.9 mSv/day on planetary surfaces.
rules.search_text: V1 4033 Galactic cosmic radiation design limits For habitats designed for more than 60 crewed days, keep GCR effective dose rates below 1.3 mSv/day in free space and 0.9 mSv/day on planetary surfaces.

rules.title: Blood-forming organ dose limits
rules.rule_summary: BFO limits are 250 mGy-Eq over 30 days and 500 mGy-Eq over one year. The career entry is inapplicable.
rules.search_text: Table 4.8-1 (BFO) Blood-forming organ dose limits BFO limits are 250 mGy-Eq over 30 days and 500 mGy-Eq over one year. The career entry is inapplicable.

rules.title: Skin dose limits
rules.rule_summary: Skin limits are 1,500, 3,000 and 6,000 mGy-Eq over 30 days, one year and a career, respectively.
rules.search_text: Table 4.8-1 (Skin) Skin dose limits Skin limits are 1,500, 3,000 and 6,000 mGy-Eq over 30 days, one year and a career, respectively.

rules.title: Lens dose limits
rules.rule_summary: Lens limits are 1,000, 2,000 and 4,000 mGy-Eq over 30 days, one year and a career, respectively.
rules.search_text: Table 4.8-1 (Lens) Lens dose limits Lens limits are 1,000, 2,000 and 4,000 mGy-Eq over 30 days, one year and a career, respectively.

rules.title: Circulatory dose limits
rules.rule_summary: Dose averaged across heart muscle and adjacent arteries is limited to 250, 500 and 1,000 mGy-Eq over 30 days, one year and a career, respectively.
rules.search_text: Table 4.8-1 (Circulatory) Circulatory dose limits Dose averaged across heart muscle and adjacent arteries is limited to 250, 500 and 1,000 mGy-Eq over 30 days, one year and a career, respectively.

rules.title: Central nervous system dose limits
rules.rule_summary: Hippocampal limits are 500, 1,000 and 1,500 mGy over 30 days, one year and a career. For ions with Z >= 10, annual and career limits are 100 and 250 mGy. The table gives no 30-day value for those ions.
rules.search_text: Table 4.8-1 (CNS) Central nervous system dose limits Hippocampal limits are 500, 1,000 and 1,500 mGy over 30 days, one year and a career. For ions with Z >= 10, annual and career limits are 100 and 250 mGy. The table gives no 30-day value for those ions.

rules.title: Nominal habitat CO2
rules.rule_summary: The requirement applies to the one-hour mean in inhabited cabin volume. Off-nominal response criteria are mission-specific.
rules.verbatim_rule: The system shall limit the average one-hour CO2 partial pressure (ppCO2) in the habitable volume to no more than 3 mmHg.
rules.search_text: V2 6004 habitat CO2 rolling one-hour mean ppCO2.

rules.title: Inspired oxygen exposure bands
rules.rule_summary: Table 6.2-1 defines inspired oxygen exposure bands by duration. Its normoxia target is 145–155 mmHg PIO2. Interpreting a dry cabin oxygen reading also requires ambient pressure.
rules.search_text: V2 6003 inspired oxygen PIO2 duration normoxia hypoxia hyperoxia.

rules.title: Total pressure for indefinite exposure
rules.rule_summary: The indefinite exposure range is above 34.5 kPa through 103 kPa inclusive. DCS mitigation is a separate program requirement under V2 6008.
rules.search_text: V2 6006 total cabin pressure indefinite exposure.

rules.title: Ground validation of DCS mitigation
rules.rule_summary: Programs validate mission-specific mitigation in ground chamber exposures. The target is a DCS probability below 4% at 95% confidence, with no serious DCS and assessment of venous gas emboli. This requirement governs ground protocol validation.
rules.search_text: V2 6008 decompression sickness DCS ground chamber protocol validation venous gas emboli.

rules.title: Cabin temperature and humidity envelope
rules.rule_summary: Figure 6.2-2 specifies a joint temperature and humidity envelope for occupied pressurized operations, with exceptions for suited operations, ascent, entry, landing and postlanding.
rules.search_text: V2 6012 cabin humidity temperature envelope operating limits.

rules.title: Continuous noise in crew sleep areas
rules.rule_summary: Crew quarters and sleep areas on missions longer than 30 days use the NC-40 octave-band limits. V2 6078 separately covers workspace noise using NC-50.
rules.search_text: V2 6079 sleep crew quarters continuous noise NC-40 octave bands.

rules.title: Countermeasure capability for orthostatic intolerance
rules.rule_summary: The vehicle must support orthostatic countermeasures during return to gravity and sustained head-to-foot acceleration. The requirement establishes a system capability.
rules.search_text: V2 7042 orthostatic intolerance return to gravity acceleration countermeasure capability.

rules.title: Heat storage during nominal suited operations
rules.rule_summary: Nominal suited heat storage must fall between −1.9 and +3.0 kJ/kg, exclusive, using the 41 Node Man or Wissler model. The constrained quantity is stored energy per unit mass.
rules.search_text: V2 11011 EVA spacesuit modeled heat storage thermoregulation.

rules.title: Ammonia (NH3) 1-Hour SMAC
rules.search_text: Ammonia (NH3) 1-Hour SMAC The one-hour ammonia exposure limit is 30 ppm.
rules.rule_summary: The one-hour ammonia exposure limit is 30 ppm.

rules.title: Ammonia (NH3) 24-Hour & Long-Term SMAC
rules.search_text: Ammonia (NH3) 24-Hour & Long-Term SMAC Ammonia limits are 20 ppm for 24 hours and 3 ppm for each listed longer duration.
rules.rule_summary: Ammonia limits are 20 ppm for 24 hours and 3 ppm for each listed longer duration.

rules.title: Carbon Monoxide (CO) SMACs
rules.search_text: Carbon Monoxide (CO) SMACs Carbon monoxide limits decrease from 425 ppm for one hour to 15 ppm at 30, 180 and 1000 days.
rules.rule_summary: Carbon monoxide limits decrease from 425 ppm for one hour to 15 ppm at 30, 180 and 1000 days.

rules.title: Hydrazine (N2H4) SMACs
rules.search_text: Hydrazine (N2H4) SMACs Hydrazine limits decrease to 0.004 ppm at 180 days. The table gives no 1000-day limit.
rules.rule_summary: Hydrazine limits decrease to 0.004 ppm at 180 days. The table gives no 1000-day limit.
